title: ECX for upper gastrointestinal cancer
schedule_label: Day 1 epirubicin and cisplatin. Take capecitabine twice daily throughout days 1–21 of each 21-day cycle. There is no planned tablet break between continuing cycles.
schedule_summary: Day 1 epirubicin and cisplatin. Take capecitabine twice daily throughout days 1–21 of each 21-day cycle. There is no planned tablet break between continuing cycles. For surgery, plan three cycles before and three after. In advanced disease continue while helping and tolerable.
purpose: When the cancer is resectable, treatment before and after surgery aims to reduce recurrence. When the cancer is advanced, treatment aims to control it and ease symptoms. Confirm which plan applies.
indication_text: Perioperative treatment of resectable gastric adenocarcinoma. Perioperative treatment of resectable gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Perioperative treatment of resectable lower oesophageal adenocarcinoma. Palliative treatment of locally advanced or metastatic gastric adenocarcinoma. Palliative treatment of locally advanced or metastatic gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
administration_text: IV fluids are given around cisplatin. Report reduced urine, tinnitus or hearing change. Swallow capecitabine with water within 30 minutes of a meal. Record your doses. Leave out a missed or vomited dose and call for advice if unwell.
monitoring_summary: Review blood counts, kidney function, electrolytes and liver tests before the next cycle. Check hearing, hydration and urine output. Record cumulative epirubicin and investigate cardiac symptoms.
review_status: Independent oncology, pharmacy and patient review pending.

agents.name: Epirubicin
agents.mechanism: Interferes with the enzymes that help cells copy and repair DNA.
agents.explanation: Interferes with the enzymes that help cells copy and repair DNA.
visual: Interferes with the enzymes that help cells copy and repair DNA.
agents.watch: Tell the nurse immediately if the IV site stings or swells.
consent_risks: Risk increases with total exposure. Report breathlessness, swollen ankles or palpitations.
Pain or burning during the injection needs immediate attention. Fever or shivering needs an urgent call.
Hair loss is common. Report ulcers that limit food or fluid intake.

agents.name: Cisplatin
agents.mechanism: Makes links in DNA that interfere with cell division.
agents.explanation: Makes links in DNA that interfere with cell division.
visual: Makes links in DNA that interfere with cell division.
agents.watch: Call the team for reduced urine, persistent vomiting or ringing in the ears.
consent_risks: IV fluids and blood tests protect the kidneys. Report reduced urine or dehydration.
Report ringing in the ears, hearing loss or numbness before the next treatment.
Take the prescribed anti-sickness cover. Call urgently if unable to drink or if you feel feverish.

agents.name: Capecitabine
agents.explanation: The body converts capecitabine into fluorouracil, which disrupts DNA and RNA processes needed for cell growth. Tablets are active chemotherapy; taking them at home still requires a clear monitoring and interruption plan.
agents.watch: Stop tablets and contact the team for significant diarrhoea, painful mouth ulcers, hand-foot soreness affecting activities, fever or dehydration. Chest pain needs urgent assessment. Do not restart until instructed.
risks: Severe early toxicity including DPD-related toxicity
consent_risks: Hold tablets and call for significant diarrhoea, painful mouth ulcers or hands and feet painful enough to limit activity.
Chest pain or severe early symptoms
Chest pain needs emergency assessment. Severe early diarrhoea, dehydration or fever needs urgent oncology review.

common_effects.title: Mouth and bowel
common_effects.text: Ring for painful ulcers, persistent diarrhoea or inability to drink.

common_effects.title: Fatigue and appetite
common_effects.text: Tell the team about weight loss or difficulty swallowing so that nutrition support can be arranged.

common_effects.title: Fluid and hearing changes
common_effects.text: Report reduced urine or ringing in the ears.

serious_effects.title: Infection
serious_effects.text: Phone oncology immediately for fever, shivering or sudden illness. For severe chest pain, severe breathing difficulty or collapse call 112 or 999.

serious_effects.title: Chest pain
serious_effects.text: Fluoropyrimidines can affect blood flow to the heart. Seek emergency help for new severe chest pain.

serious_effects.title: Severe early toxicity
serious_effects.text: Contact oncology immediately for severe diarrhoea, mouth ulcers or fever early in a course.

serious_effects.title: Injection site
serious_effects.text: Tell the nurse straight away about burning, pain or swelling while epirubicin is being given.

evidence.title: REAL-2 / FLOT4
evidence.interpretation: In advanced disease, the pooled comparisons supported substitution of capecitabine for infused fluorouracil and oxaliplatin for cisplatin. The trial did not compare these with modern immunotherapy combinations. In resectable gastric or junctional adenocarcinoma, perioperative FLOT improved median survival versus the ECF/ECX comparator group. The trial did not independently compare ECX with surgery alone.
evidence.limitations: These results describe selected trial populations. Your outlook depends on your disease, fitness and treatment setting.

monitoring_schedule.title: Tests and timing

rows.label: Before starting
cells: Check blood count, kidney and liver function and DPD status before starting. Review cardiac function, prior anthracycline exposure and lifetime epirubicin dose.
Bring your medicine list and oncology contact details.

rows.label: Before the next cycle
cells: Review blood counts, kidney function, electrolytes and liver tests before the next cycle. Check hearing, hydration and urine output. Record cumulative epirubicin and investigate cardiac symptoms.
Tell the team about symptoms and missed doses.

rows.label: At review
cells: Review symptoms, nutrition, weight and treatment response.
Ask when scans or surgery will be discussed.

rows.label: Around surgery
cells: The protocol schedules surgery 3–6 weeks after cycle 3 and cycle 4 at 6–12 weeks after surgery.
Restart depends on recovery and the treating team.

monitoring_schedule.note: For surgery, plan three cycles before and three after. In advanced disease continue while helping and tolerable.
